Your Name

Biotechnology student working in the lab and in code, with a focus on bioinformatics.

Open to internships, training and research

See projectsDownload CV

About me

I study biotechnology and use computational tools to answer biological questions. I like following a sample all the way: from the bench, to the sequencer, to a figure I can explain.

I am building my bioinformatics skills project by project, with documented code and results that others can repeat.

Genomics / Transcriptomics / Microbial evolution / Structure-based drug design

Education

BSc Biotechnology, University Name

  1. Year 1

    Foundations

    General biology, chemistry, lab safety and microscopy.

  2. Year 2

    Molecular biology

    DNA extraction, PCR and cloning. First scripts in Python.

  3. Year 3

    Genomics and data

    Linux, R and biostatistics. First RNA-seq analysis.

  4. Year 4

    Research

    Graduation project that combines lab work and sequence analysis.

Technical and laboratory skills

At the bench

  • DNA and RNA extraction
  • PCR and qPCR
  • Gel electrophoresis
  • SDS-PAGE and Western blot
  • Bacterial transformation
  • Cell culture
  • ELISA
  • Spectrophotometry

At the computer

Programming
Python, R, Bash, Git
Sequence analysis
BLAST, FastQC, HISAT2, samtools, GATK
Statistics and plots
DESeq2, ggplot2, pandas
Structure and evolution
PyMOL, AutoDock Vina, MAFFT, IQ-TREE

Bioinformatics projects

Differential expression from RNA-seq

Which genes respond to the treatment? A ranked gene list with a volcano plot and pathway enrichment.

FastQC → HISAT2 → featureCounts → DESeq2

CodeReport

Variant calling pipeline

Which variants does this sample carry? An annotated VCF, filtered by quality and predicted effect.

BWA → samtools → GATK → VEP

CodeReport

16S rRNA phylogeny

Where does the isolate sit among known species? A supported tree that places the isolate next to its closest relatives.

BLAST → MAFFT → IQ-TREE

CodeReport

Molecular docking

How does the ligand sit in the active site? Ranked binding poses with the hydrogen bonds that hold each one.

PDB → AutoDock Vina → PyMOL

CodeReport
